title: skills: objectstack-ui list-views teaches kanban settings without the cardFooter comment and attachment counts #36423 adds
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet (the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of the #36423 code PR; the area thread's report, the PR follows)

## What happens

The #36423 code PR adds one key to `KanbanConfigSchema`: `kanban.cardFooter`, a strict object with two booleans, `comments` and `attachments`. Each turns on a count in the card's footer, read with one grouped query per board. The comment count is the record's open top-level threads. The attachment count is read only when the object has `enable.files`. Any other member is refused by name.

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` "Configuring Kanban Views" (origin/main, :254-290) shows every `kanban:` setting an author writes (`groupByField`, `lanes`, `summary`, `showFieldLabels`, `hideEmptyFields`, `columns`) and has no `cardFooter`. An agent asked for "show comment counts on the cards" finds no key there and either invents one, which the strict schema refuses, or says it can't be done.

`skills/**` is governed (Tier H), so this text does not ride the code PR.

## Expected

- In that section's example or the notes under it, one line for `cardFooter: { comments: true, attachments: true }`. Say that comments count open top-level threads, that attachments need `enable.files` on the object (with it off, the count is not shown), and that no other member is accepted.
- Pay for the line in the same file under the token ratchet (no ceiling moves).
- Write it against the merged code PR's tree: key spelling, the two members, and when each count is shown.

Blocked-by: #36423 (its code PR merges)
Category ①: a shipped skill would teach an incomplete key list for a setting the platform reads, so an agent cannot author a feature the board has.
Priority: p2, the grade of #36423.
Business reason: app builders who ask an agent for card counts on a board get them only if the skill names the key.
Reader: seat 2 area s2-ux-L (repo:objectstack#2), after the code PR merges; Tier H, so os-zhuang approves.
Dedupe: `list-views cardFooter` and `kanban cardFooter skills` (open issues), 0 hits besides #36423 itself.
Related: #36423.
